hero.title: Websites and web apps —
hero.text: I design and build websites, applications and automations tailored to your business. I listen to your expectations, but I always remember that users come first.

services.title: How I can
services.text: From a simple business card site, through an app for your team, to a script that takes boring, repetitive work off your plate.

websites.title: Websites
websites.text: Fast, responsive sites that clearly say what you do and lead visitors to get in touch.

webapps.title: Web applications
webapps.text: Tailor-made tools: dashboards, booking systems, team management apps.

uiux.title: UI/UX design
uiux.text: A design we test on a clickable prototype before writing code — when changes are cheapest.

automation.title: Automation
automation.text: Less clicking, more results. If a process eats hours of your team's time, I'll turn it into a script.
automation.example: Processing GPS data files: 4–5 days of work → 2 clicks.

process.title: How we
process.text: Five steps from the first call to post-launch support.

talk.title: Discussion
talk.text: I learn about your business, the site's goal and your brand style. We agree on scope and who prepares copy and photos.

design.title: Design and quote
design.text: I prepare a visual design and a functional outline. Together with it you get a quote that won't change.

build.title: Development
build.text: Once the design is approved, I code. I'm available whenever new ideas or changes come up.

review.title: Presentation
review.text: I show you the finished site or app. Minor tweaks are made right away.

support.title: Support
support.text: I help with hosting, SEO and questions after launch. Our work doesn't end at handover.

card.text: A few pages that present you and your offer.
card.f1: Up to 5 pages and a contact form

landing.title: Landing page
landing.text: A single page focused on one goal — sign-ups, sales or enquiries.
landing.f1: Structure that leads to one goal
landing.f2: Sections ready for campaigns and ads

app.title: Custom application
app.text: A web app or automation that solves a specific problem in your company.

responsive.title: Responsive design
responsive.text: Your site works and looks good on phones, tablets and desktops.

seo.title: Basic SEO
seo.text: Proper heading structure, metadata and clean page URLs.

speed.title: Speed
speed.text: Lean code and optimised images — pages load without the wait.

support.title: Post-launch support
support.text: I'll help with hosting, updates and questions after launch too.

portfolio.title: Selected
portfolio.text: Websites, apps and automations — with source code to look at.

hosting.q: Will you take care of hosting?
hosting.a: Yes. I'll help you choose hosting for the project and set it up. A simple site can often be hosted very cheaply, while an app with a backend needs a server — I'll recommend the most sensible option.

domain.a: If you already have a domain, I'll connect it to the new site. If not, I'll help you choose and register one in your name, so it always belongs to you.

content.q: Who prepares the copy and photos?
content.a: We settle this in the first call: you can provide ready materials, I can prepare them, or we work with someone else. Graphics and photos are handled the same way.

time.a: It depends on the scope: a landing page or business card site usually takes a few weeks, an application longer. I give you a specific deadline together with the design and quote.

cta.title: Let's talk about
cta.text: Tell me what you need — I'll reply within 1 business day and suggest a time for a short call.

time.a: It depends on the format: a reel or an episode edit usually takes a few days, a full promo video from one to several weeks. We agree on the deadline up front, and when footage arrives last minute I do my best to deliver on time without cutting corners.

revisions.a: We agree on the number of revision rounds together with the quote. Small changes after the presentation are made right away — I want you to be fully happy with the result.

formats.q: What file format will I get?
formats.a: By default MP4 (H.264) at the resolution and aspect ratio of the target platform: 16:9 for YouTube and websites, 9:16 for reels. Graphics come as PNG or JPG. Other formats on request.

recording.a: Either option works. For promo videos I do the filming. For vlogs and gaming you usually record, and I take the raw footage and handle the editing.
